chunks: The mountains were put in motion, turning into a mirage.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the absolute power of Allah to dismantle the most enduring symbols of earthly stability, serving as a tangible sign for those who witness the Resurrection. The transformation of mountains into 'sarab' (a mirage or scattered dust) underscores the transient nature of the material world compared to the eternal reality of the Hereafter, reinforcing the concept of *Ba'th* (Resurrection) as a physical and cosmic event.
